free_tier.stated: No free tier and no single-GPU rental: whole 8-GPU bare-metal nodes only. B200 in Los Angeles USD 8.40 per GPU-hour month-to-month from November 2026; B300 in Kuala Lumpur USD 9.00 for 3 months paid up front; B300 in Iowa USD 4.70 on 36 months and USD 4.50 on 60. No H100, A100, L40S, RTX 4090 or L4 is listed.

tooling: SSH with root onto whole bare-metal nodes with the organisation's public keys installed; a machine-readable rate card at GET /api/v1/pricing.
chaining: A Blackwell-only lane: none of the five common cards is sold. The rate is competitive for B200 and B300 but needs KYC, a quote and a multi-month term.

limits_note: Launching needs KYC and a signed capacity agreement; the nodes are sold whole (8 GPUs) and the cheapest terms are 36 or 60 months take-or-pay.

identity_cost.detail: The terms state the service 'is offered to businesses and professional users only' and that 'Launching instances requires prior verification (know-your-customer and export-control screening)'. The order path is a quote request, KYC, then a master services agreement and an invoice. Payment is by wire transfer, card or USDC per the index; the vendor page names wire transfer for the 30 percent prepayment.
identity_cost.country: a business entity; the operator is registered in the Dubai International Financial Centre

reliability_note: The index notes the service was not available until Q4 2026 and is limited to a US data centre; the vendor page states B200 is available from November 2026 and states a 99.975 percent monthly uptime SLA for the Kuala Lumpur block. No outage was observed.
